messages.content:
Hi all,

Inspired by Thomas Bloom's Erdős Problems, I built a preprint server designed to host AI-generated mathematical papers. My main motivation was to create a place for papers like the OpenAI writeup about the unit distance problem.

Here's a prototype. There are only dummy papers so far, but the core features are live: one can create accounts, submit papers and review the work of others. Feel free to try it out.

I’m curious to hear your thoughts. Could a platform like this become a useful piece of mathematical infrastructure? And if so, what design decisions matter most?
